title: Jacobi.Midi exchange file
description: The message exchange patterns of one map root (see readme.md). The same content as the XML format (exchange.xsd): elements that repeat are arrays. Not expressed here, checked by the reader: 'goto' names a state of the same exchange, every state can be reached from the first one, 'sent' needs a 'send' in the state, 'complete' a 'receive', and names of exchanges and states are unique, ignoring case.

for.description: The schema name of the map root whose ranges these exchanges transfer, e.g. 'Gx700.AddressMap'.

responseTimeout.description: Milliseconds a state waits for an event; default 1000 (an exchange takes the file's value).

messageInterval.description: The least number of milliseconds between two messages sent to the device; default 0 (an exchange takes the file's value).

messageName.description: The schema name of a message group: document, root and path, e.g. 'Roland.Message32.RQ1'.

exchange.description: One exchange: a state machine that runs once per block of the range; the first state is the start.

name.description: A standard name (requestData, sendData) or a name of the file's own.

state.description: On entry the state sends its message (if any), then waits for the events it has an 'on' for.

send.description: The message to build for the block and send on entry.

receive.description: The data messages whose data is accepted for the block while in the state, and counts towards 'complete'.

on.description: The transitions; the first one that matches is taken.

transition.description: On the event or message: go to a state, or end the run for the block with a result.
